# Founder Directive — Batch D Comparative Research (2026-11-04)

**Decision:** Batch D is now the next core research assignment for ClimateOS CarbonOS, superseding the previous D1/D2-only feasibility framing. This directive is a **research-design authorization only**, NOT authorization for model execution, emissions calculation, deployment, merge or scientific admission. Read PR #132 latest C2 review #6627278919 and current `docs/research/carbonos/INDEX.md`, `NEXT_SESSION.md`, P1-A formula registry, B/B2/B3 facility evidence, C/C2 weather/measurement readiness before starting.

## Research question
For the **same waste process, compatible input/activity history, common physical accounting boundary and time support**, how do (A) conventional factor or historic statutory accounting, (B) established time-dynamic models such as IPCC landfill FOD, and (C) a proposed climate-responsive process model differ in temporal estimates, annual integrals, uncertainty and agreement with **independent measured gas emissions**? **Do not presume C outperforms A/B.** Distinguish legal credited tCO2e, inventory CH4 generation, actual atmospheric CH4 flux, collection/destruction, and biogenic/fossil CO2. These are not automatically comparable targets.

## Required work packages
**D0 – scientific comparison contract:** Select one homogeneous process class first (prefer landfill CH4; lagoon wastewater is separate extension). Define common measurable endpoint (e.g. CH4 emitted mass per defined time/footprint), common activity history, units, reference T/P, wet/dry basis, oxidation/capture/storage terms, annual vs event resolution, GWP vintage and input availability. Mark legal AWT2015 as historical *rule comparator* rather than falsely claiming its statutory output equals site-level measured flux. Include an explicit `NOT_COMPARABLE` outcome when quantities differ.

**D1 – baseline methods:** Trace primary versions, original equations, assumptions, activity-data requirements, temporal aggregation and uncertainty for (A) historical AWT2015/factor approach and (B) IPCC 2006/2019 FOD and any other justified current accepted inventory method. Do not relabel all conventional methods static. Preserve AWT formula register unchanged; never insert a weather multiplier into statutory formulas.

**D2 – climate-responsive candidate:** Literature-backed process diagram separating methanogenesis, oxidation, capture, combustion and emitted flux; temperature of actual process vs air proxy, moisture, precipitation/infiltration, redox/oxygen, substrate, gas transport/storage, operational controls, event lag. Define mathematically testable model *families* and parameter-identifiability conditions, without invented coefficients, new proprietary claims or running a model. Latitude/elevation are contextual variables, not direct kinetics.

**D3 – independent validation data discovery:** Seek lawfully reusable *real* facility/field time series with meteorology/process measurements and CH4 flux/collection or N2O when justified. Log original dataset availability, reuse licence, observation method, station/site geometry, QC, measurement uncertainty, time support, operations, and held-out period/site. If no suitable dataset exists, return `DATA_NOT_READY` and a prioritized access plan, not synthetic evidence or guessed outputs. Do not reattempt known blocked endpoints.

**D4 – comparison and falsification protocol:** Pre-register shared input set, calibration/train and time-blocked holdout, same target and baseline assumptions, seasonal/extreme-event strata, uncertainty intervals, sensitivity, overfitting tests, negative controls and failure conditions. Define metrics MAE/RMSE/bias and coverage where appropriate, plus annual cumulative and event peak/timing. Avoid leakage of retrospective climate indices into real-time forecast tests. A more complex C is not automatically better.

**D5 – Founder decision and presentation:** Produce 10–14-page offline **Slides-style** paginated HTML (keyboard/mobile navigation, evidence drilldown, clear supported/hypothesis/blocked labels), concise executive recommendation, exact source receipts, machine-readable method comparison and data-readiness matrix, CRP handoff. Commit only public-safe materials to PR #132 Draft branch, update `docs/research/carbonos/INDEX.md` and `NEXT_SESSION.md`, link Issue #131 and PR #132; preserve SHA and failed/unknown states. Do not publish licensed full papers or private Council data.

## Acceptance gate
Deliver a defensible answer to: *what exactly is being compared; what is already dynamic in mainstream methods; what additional process variation is C proposing; what data could falsify its claimed advantage; and what is the smallest separately authorizable experiment?* Mark outcomes `ACCEPT / REVISE / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE / NOT_COMPARABLE`. No actual A/B/C numeric run, no climate-response coefficient invented, no ACCU calculation, no national emissions total, no field activity or external outreach, no paid access, no new agent/database infrastructure, no PR merge or deployment. Keep **P1-A scientific admission PENDING** and PR #132 Draft.

**Next handoff:** After committing Batch D research package, request ChatGPT scientific review and Founder decision before any numerical experiment.

CRP: Knowledge—traditional methods include dynamic FOD; idea—three-method comparison under same measurable target; desire—climate-responsive explanatory and predictive skill; reasoning—same boundary + independent measured outcomes needed; decision—Batch D comparative research is core; open—public field flux data and parameter identifiability; next—Codex Batch D research only; keywords ClimateOS, CarbonOS, AWT, IPCC FOD, CH4, climate response, MRV, uncertainty, extreme weather.

# ChatGPT Scientific & Strategic Review — Batch C2 (2026-11-04)

Reviewed exact Draft PR #132 HEAD `61cf333ed980d77267f739b3c36b5aff48b4d1e4`, including `docs/research/carbonos/batch-c2/README.md`, `EVENT_QUALITY_REGISTER.json`, `OBSERVATION_QUALITY_AUDIT.md`, `ACCESS_ATTEMPTS.json`, `FIELD_MEASUREMENT_CHECKLIST.md`, `MEASUREMENT_READINESS.json`, `FUTURE_REPLAY_PROTOCOL.md`, `EVIDENCE_MATRIX.md`, `NEXT_SESSION.md`, `evidence/validation.json`, plus GitHub PR metadata, file listing and review-request #6627230199.

**Disposition: ACCEPT_WITH_LIMITS, PREPARATION_ONLY. P1-A scientific admission remains PENDING.** PR remains OPEN/DRAFT/NOT_MERGED. No commit status checks or associated PR workflow runs were returned. Reported local structural/browser 20-combination QA is not a provider raw-data QC test or CI result.

## Evidence and methodological findings

1. **ACCEPT:** Distinct evidence layers are preserved: published Cooma 2019-01-16 Tmax 37.9°C and Rockhampton 2018-11-25 Tmax 41.5°C; provider data legend / product-level timing; station metadata; raw daily observation bytes. Both raw daily exports **NOT_OBTAINED**. Event QC flags, window completeness, source-file digest and UTC bounds remain null. No fabricated time series.
2. **ACCEPT:** Acquisition failures are separated: inaccessible tool route, interactive timeout and *unvalidated constructed URL* do not establish absent observations, authoritative HTTP403 or a legal access denial. Stop repeated blind parameter probing; future retrieval must use an authorised, documented provider route or supplied legitimate export.
3. **ACCEPT WITH LIMITS:** Rockhampton entire Tmax holdings completeness reported 99.8% is not completeness for the selected 2018 event window. Cooma metadata is search-only and station moves/event-era calibration are unknown. Nominal 9am Tmax assignment must not be converted to UTC based solely on modern civil timezone; BOM product and station-era time conventions require evidence.
4. **REVISE BEFORE EXECUTION:** Fixed `Tmax >=35°C` is an *analyst screening threshold*, not BOM heatwave definition; known-case retrospective selection precludes prevalence or prospective confirmation. Proposed t-7/t+30 descriptive window and 0–1/2–7/8–30 day lag families are uncalibrated study proposals, not reactor kinetics. Reassess need for an event-window length using data availability and process-specific hypotheses; avoid unnecessarily hard-coding 100% completeness as an external standard (it is acceptable only as an explicitly chosen stringent internal gate).
5. **ACCEPT AS PLANNING:** 12 checklist items distinguish process T/moisture, organic and nitrogen loads, operation states, ambient/species flux, dissolved gas, collection, flare, biogenic/fossil carbon and energy/refrigerants. Concentration != flux; captured != destroyed; N2O-N != N2O; air T != reactor/landfill core T. They are candidate requirements, not existing observations or an approved field sampling SOP. Qualified specialist review remains necessary.
6. **INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE:** No event-to-facility spatial exposure join, matched process/flux observation, emissions effect, AWT creditable calculation, or independent scientific validation. Four facility candidates remain partially identified.

## Next strategic step — avoid recursive preparation loops

**C2 accepted as evidence-readiness milestone; do not launch another nearly identical URL-probe/QC-paperwork micro-batch.** Draft a consolidated **Batch D Gate / Data-Readiness Decision** that compares two bounded routes:
- **D1 weather-only provenance replay**: identify one legitimate, publicly permitted source of daily temperature observations (not guessed URL); specify precisely the native QC legend, version, clock/interval and local-only reuse, then request Founder approval *before actually running any numerical replay*. If not accessible, STOP and document alternative official export process without fabricated data.
- **D2 independent public measurement case**: locate an existing published, legally reusable landfill or lagoon time-series study with *both* weather/process and measured CH4 or N2O flux, if possible. Check original dataset availability, sampling time support and confounders, not just a paper abstract. Do not substitute Cooma/Rockhampton site readings or transplant coefficients without validation. Propose, but do not run, a single-process sensitivity study.

Prepare a **single decision-oriented paginated Slides overview** with paths, evidence readiness, blockers, acceptance/failure gates, relative science value, time/cost constraints, and explicit Founder decision. Update `docs/research/carbonos/INDEX.md` and `NEXT_SESSION.md` on PR #132 with SHA/source receipts and clear science statuses.

**Not authorised:** emission calculator, model run/simulation, numerical weather replay, national estimate, official ACCU compliance conclusion, Council-private data, site visits/outreach, purchases, PR merge, deployment or promotion of science status. No raw copyright-restricted source files in the public PR.

CRP: core—metadata is not event QC; process measurements unavailable; idea—transition from repeated preparation loops to a two-route decision gate; desire—reproducible weather and public flux science; reasoning—source legitimacy and actual measured outcomes precede inference; decision—C2 ACCEPT_WITH_LIMITS, Batch D proposal only; open—daily source, QC/clock, site-process-gas dataset; next—Founder-facing D1/D2 gate; tags—ClimateOS CarbonOS EcoEngine BOM CH4 N2O AWT MRV extreme climate.
